༄༅/ /zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi zhal gdams gab sbas snying dang 'dra ba rnams bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi zhal gdams gab sbas snying dang 'dra ba rnams bzhugs so//

dpal ya mānta ka la phyag 'tshal lo// yang zlog me'i spu gri'i bsnyen sgrub kyi zhal gdams gud du sbas pa zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi gab sbas snying dang 'dra ba 'ga' zhig 'dir bshad pa ni/ dang po bsnyen pa 'bum phrag drug po gzhi bsnyen rang du bstan pa ltar grub rjes/ gnyis pa nye bsnyen gyi tshe/ dur khrod kyi sa tshon gyi dkyil 'khor zhal bzhes mthong brgyud ltar bri/ de'i dbus su 'jam dbyangs zhi khro gang rung gi sku bris 'bur gang yang rung ba bsham/ sgrub rdzas gzhan rnams bsnyen pa'i skabs ltar bsham/ lha bskyed dus bdag mdun tha mi dad du bskyed la bsnyen pa 'bum phrag gsum po gzhi bsnyen du bshad pa ltar bya'o// gsum pa sgrub pa chen po'i skabs ni/ tsandan dmar po'i byang bu dkyus sor lnga/ zhing sor gsum yod pa gnyis kyi byang bu/ gcig la yi dam gyi sku'i khong par sgrub sngags la 'dod gsol sham bu btags pa dang*/ gcig la rang gzugs kyi khong par rang gi gsang mtshan la dngos grub kyi 'dod byang btags pa bris/ byang bu gnyis kyi rgyab tu 'bru gsum rten 'brel snying po rab gnas sngags rnams bri/ yang byang bu gnyis la lha gzugs dang*/ rang gzugs 'bri ma thub na lha sngags dang rang gi gsang mtshan gyi mthar 'dod gsol btags pas kyang rung*/ lha byang la chos sman dang bdag byang la rang gi shu kra byugs chus mi 'jig pa'i rtsi btang*/ zhal sbyar la dar tshon gyis dril zhing tshon skud kyis bcings| byang bu 'bri rdzas rab gser dngul/ 'bring mtshal/ tha ma rgya snag las bya/ dngos grub kyi rdzas thod pa mtshan ldan du/ ba dmar ser gyi 'o ma/ bu ram/ sbrang*/ ka ra/ chos sman/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ bum rdzas nyer lnga rnams sbyar bas bkang chang cung zad kyang blug /de'i nang du lha byang zhal rang la bstan cing*/ bdag byang zhal lhar phyogs par byas la mgo mjug ma log par gzhug /thod pa mtshan ldan gcig gis steng nas bkab/

'di la thod pa mtshan ldan pho mo kha sbyor byung na rab/ ma byung na pho thod gnyis la bya/ mo thod gnyis kha sbyar mi nyan/ thod pa dar kha dog lngas dril la mañdzi la sogs pa'i steng du sngar nye bsnyen gyi rdul tshon dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi khar bzhag /gzung thag dmar po btags/ dkyil 'khor gyi mthar dngos grub kyi rdzas thod pa mtshan ldan chang dang chos sman gyis bkang ba dang*/ tshogs rdzas bza' bca' btung ba kha na ma tho ba med pa ci 'dzom/ tshe gal/ thun gsum/ gzhan yang bkra shis pa'i rdzas dang yo byad sna tshogs pa bshams nas dmigs pa dang sngags bzla tshul rnams gzhi bsnyen du bshad pa ltar 'bum phrag gcig po skyon rnams spangs nas thems par bzla/ 'bum phrag gcig po thems nas sngags mthar/ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐/ zhes btags pa khri phrag gcig las mi nyung ba bzlas rjes/ dngos grub bsdus te blang ba ni/ dam bsre dngos grub blang ba'i sngags bsdebs kyang stong tsam bzlas la/ 'di rjes 'dod yon 'byung ba'i sngags bsdebs kyang ci 'grub bzla la/ nam gung yol tsam la tshogs rdzas rnams byin gyis rlabs nas lha la 'bul ba'i bar byas nas/ rang nyid tshogs la longs ma spyad pa'i snga rol du nam tho rangs la bab pa'i tshe/ hoḥ nam mkha'i khams mnyam zil gnon 'jam dpal dbyangs// sku yi dngos grub nam mkha'i dkyil yangs shing*// gsung gi dngos grub 'gag med brjod dang bral// thugs kyi dngos grub mi rtog mnyam pa'i ngang*// yon tan dngos grub yid bzhin rin chen gter// phrin las dngos grub rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyi// dngos grub rnam gnyis dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor// ji ltar bsam pa'i dngos grub bstsal du gsol// gnas skabs nad gdon bar gcod la sogs pa// mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs kun zhi ba dang*// tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod dbang*// mnga' thang snyan grags dgos dgu rgyas pa dang*// mos bzhi'i khams gsum srid gsum lha mi nor// yid la gang 'dod dbang du 'du ba dang*// bstan dang bla mar do bsdo bdag la 'tshe// dgra bgegs gang byung drag pos sgrol ba sogs// rnam bzhi las kyi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// mthar thug bdag don phun tshogs 'jam dpal dbyangs// ye shes sems dpa'i go 'phang myur thob cing*// gzhan don nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam sems can rnams// gang la gang 'dul gzugs skus chos bstan nas// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sa la rab 'god pa'i// don gnyis phun tshogs dngos grub deng stsol cig

/hūm̐ */ yi dam rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bdag nyid rig 'dzin sgrub pa po'i// 'dzab bsnyen grangs su thems zin gyi// bskyed rdzogs drod tshad thob zin gyi// thugs dam gnyan po bskangs zin gyi// sgrub pa'i zhag grangs thems zin gyi// rdo rje srin po nam langs nye// dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab// dam can thugs dam bdag bskul gyi// sngon gyi thugs bskyed smon pa dang*// dam bcas ma bsnyel de dgongs la// dngos grub dam pa da lta stsol// ces lan gsum dang*/ lha yi lha mchog sogs dang*/ bskal pa dpag tu med pa'i sogs dang*/ lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma sogs dang*/ bdag kyang gnod pa las rgyal sogs dang*/ nam mkha' med pa sogs kyang brjod/ 'dod gsol yang lan gsum byas rjes/ dkyil 'khor dbus nas thod pa tshur blangs/ dbang gi dam tshig chen po'i tshul bstan khro bo'i sogs kyis rang gi gnas rnams su btug cing dbang blangs/ mthar thod pa zhal phye la rang gi bla ma bzhugs na thog mar de la drangs/ de rjes yi dam la sman byas/ de rjes thod pa'i dngos grub kyi rdzas rnams gzhan su la'ang mi sbyin par rang nyid kyis longs spyad/ de rjes tshogs dang dngos grub kyi rdzas gzhan rnams longs spyad/ lhag ma btang*/ dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod la/ ya ma rā dza'i yig brgya brgya'am nyer gcig gis chad lhag bskang*/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa lha byang la bstim/ brtan bzhugs byas la byang bu gnyis rang lus la 'bral med du bcang ngo*/ de rjes nam ma langs gong du dkyil 'khor bsdus la/ rdul tshon cung zad cig rang gi spyi bor bkod/ de min bsdus la rgyun 'bab kyi chu bor dor ram rang gi mdzod phugs su gzhug go// de nas slar nam langs su nye ba dang 'chi bdag bdud sgrub gzhi bsnyen rang du bshad pa ltar la 'jug pa yin no// de'ang dang po bsnyen pa ni/ lha bsnyen pa'i rtsa ba ste phrin las 'khor lo bskor ba la dbang*/

mchog gi dngos grub thob par byed/ gnyis pa nye bar bsnyen pa ni/ lha dam la 'du zhing dmod mo nye bar bsnyen pa yin/ phrin las thun gyi las la dbang*/ thun mong gi dngos grub gtso bor thob/ gsum pa sgrub pa chen pos ni lha gnad la dbab cing dam la 'dogs pa dang*/ phyi mi 'gyur ba'i tshe gcig la bsnyen pa rdzogs/ sgrub pa gong ma gnyis kyi dngos grub blangs ba'ang yin las rab 'byams 'grub bo// bzhi pa 'chi bdag bdud sgrub kyi ni/ mthar byed dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas pa las la 'dzud cing drag po'i phrin las gtso bor 'grub pa yin no// de rnams kyang gzhi'i chos nyid rang gsal lam gyi chos nyid rang gsal btab pas/ 'bras bu chos dbyings dri bral 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' mchog grub pa ni chos nyid yin no// yang dngos grub bsdus te len pa'i skabs/ tshe sgrub kyi kha bsgyur byed na/ tshe zan/ tshe chang*/ tshe ril sogs dkyil 'khor gyi mthar bkod la sngags sham du btags pa bzla/ cho ga'i skabs/ hoḥ zil gnon sku gsung thugs sprul pa'i// khro bo mang po'i 'phro 'du yis// tshe la gnod pa'i bgegs bkug nas// de yi gzugs bcom der dril la// gang gi tshe rnams 'dir bsdus pa// ā yuḥsrog gi gnas su bsdu// tshe dbang thams cad 'dir sdus shig /ces brjod cing longs spyod do// tshe chog 'di dngos grub kyi sgrub pa la tshe'i kha bsgyur byed na ma gtogs mi dgos la/ yang gong gi dngos grub kyi cho ga'i skabs tshe chog 'di'ang bsnan nas bsdoms la dngos grub blang yang 'gal ba med do// de ltar bsnyen pa/ nye bsnyen/ sgrub chen/ lha sgrub/ bdud sgrub dang bcas pa rnams kyi nang rtags ni rgyas par tshod 'dzin nang rtags drod tshad du bshad pa ltar dang*/ 'dir spyi mthun gtso che ba rnams nas bsdus te bshad pa ni/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa la rtags 'di rnams 'byung ste/

nang rtags su/ sku gsung thugs gang la rtag par sems lhang nge 'dug pa dang*/ lus shing bal gyi 'dab ma ltar yang ba dang*/ snang ba gang yang mthong ba dang*/ lus yod du mi tshor zhing dkyil 'khor gyi rtsar lhang nge 'dug pa dang*/ dbugs phyi nang du rgyu ba mi tshor ba dang*/ rtog med kyi bde ba rang la 'char ba ste/ bsnyen pa rdzogs shing sems las su rung ba ni rtags dang po'o// phyi rtags su/ sku gzugs 'gul ba'am/ bzhad pa'am/ steng nas lung ston pa'i sgra thos pa'i lho phyogs nas sgo bye ba snyam byed pa'am/ mdun gyi nam mkhar 'od kyi lha'i gzugs brnyan 'char ba'am/ 'od dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri zhim po dang*/ gtor ma dang sman raka khol ba dang*/ mchod rdzas dang sgrub rdzas la me 'bar ba dang*/ skyes pa dang bud med kyi tshogs sprul te gtam zer ba rnams ni mngon rtags so// nyams kyi rtags ni/ nyams mi dga' na bdud kyi bar chad yin pas nyams rtags so// rmis ltas su/ nyi ma mang po nam mkha' la shar ba dang*/ rgyal khams 'od kyis khengs pa dang*| zla ba thang la lhung ba dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon dang rtag tu 'phrad cing 'grogs pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ mchod rten la 'dzegs pa dang*/ ri rab la 'dzegs pa dang*/ rnga rdung ba dang*/ ā tsa ra mang pos gtam zer ba dang*/ mon pa nag po 'khol ba dang*/ bande'i tshul du byung ba dang*/ sngags pa dang mi nag gcer bu dar thogs pa dang*/ bud med nag mos phyag byas pa dang*/ ma dang sring mo dang mdza' mos 'tsho ba sbyor pa dang*/ brag las mi lhung ba dang*/ chu la mi bying ba dang*/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba rnams rmi'o// rtags 'di rnams yongs su rdzogs pa byung na rab/ phyed tsam rdzogs na 'bring*/ 'ga' byung na tha ma yin no/ bsnyen pa thems nas rtags rab 'bring tha ma gang rdzogs kyang dngos grub blangs te las kyi kha sbyor ba byas na gang byas kyang 'grub par 'gyur pa the tshom med do// bsnyen rtags rnams byung ba'i dus nges pa'ang*/

gshin rje'i gshed kyi bshad rgyud khri drug stong pa las/ srod 'jigs rtags byung dam sri 'dre// yin pas mtshams bcad mnan gzir bya// nam phyed tho rangs rtags byung na// lha yin mchod 'bul dngos grub blang*// zhes gsungs pas/ nam srod la byung na bar gcod dang*/ gung dang tho rangs byung na bzang ba yin no/ rtags kyi ye ge zhal gyi gdams pa'o// zhes pa rnams ni gshin rje kha thun gyi ṭī ka phan byed snying gi nyi ma dang*/ rtags yig sogs las 'byung ste yang zlog zla gsang gzhi bsnyen la med mi rung zab gnad snying dang 'dra ba yin pas/ gzhan rnams la zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gzhung de nyid ster yang 'di mi ster ba'i bka' rgya yod pas logs su khol bur bris pa yin no// de ltar gzhi bsnyen gyi sngon na bgrang phreng byin rlabs logs su yod pa ltar bya/ thun mthar gtor bsngos bstod pa sogs byed khar bzlas pa'i 'phro 'jog skabs dang bza' btung byed pa dang bshang lci 'dor ba sogs bzlas pa'i 'phro gcod khar phreng ba rdzogs nas mdud 'dzin rtsar sleb par byas la grub par gyur cig /grub bo/ grub bo/ zhes btags la lan gsum dang rten 'brel snying po lan gsum bzlas/ nam mkha' med pa sogs tshig bdun bar yang brjod/ mchan/ nas bya ba gang yin de la 'jug /yang bza' btung dang*/ bshang gci 'dor ba dang*/ gnyid dang*/ glal sbrid dang*/ snabs lud pa/ 'og rlung shor ba rnams kyi skabs bzlas pa'i sngags de dag bzlas pa'i grangs su mi bgrang*/ gzhan yang phreng skor 'khor nas mdud 'dzin rtsar ma sleb pa'i bar rnams su mi dang gtam shor na sngar bcad zin nas phreng ba rdog bzhi/ glo lu na lnga/ glal na gsum/ sbrid na bcu/ mchil snabs lud pa sogs dor na gcig /'og rlung la bdun/ gnyid na bco lnga sogs grangs su mi brtsi bar slar ldog la bgrang*/ bza' btung byed bzhin pa dang*/ bshang gci 'dor bzhin par sngags bzla ba gtan nas spang*/

bza' btung byas pa gnyid glal sbrid pa byung ba bshang lci dang 'chil snabs dor ba 'og rlung shor ba rnams kyi rjes su chab ma blang bar sngags la mi 'jug /glo lud pa nas gnyid kyi bar drug po la/ phreng rdog grangs nges can slar ldog pa ni zhi bsnyen dang zla gsang gzhi bsnyen kyi bsnyen pa dang*/ nye bsnyen dang*/ 'chi bdag bdud sgrub rnams kyi skabs yin la gzhi bsnyen gyi sgrub pa chen po'i skabs ni/ glal dang sbrid pa dang gnyid dang rkang lag brkyang bskum rnams ye ma shor ba dang*/ 'og rlung mchil snabs lud pa glo lu ba rnams byung na gong ltar phreng rdog grangs bcad slar ldog par bya'o| |gzhan yang bsnyen sgrub spyi la gces pa'i yig chung du bshad pa rnams kyang skabs su gang bab rig pas dpyad nas nyams su blang ngo*// 'di rnams ni zla gsang gzhi bsnyen gyi dgos pa gal po che rnams logs su gab sbas bgyis pa yin pas dam tshig thub nges kyi slob ma re re tsam ma gtogs su la'ang ma byin cig /kha thaṃ/ kha thaṃ/ kha thaṃ/ gambhī ra/ rje chos kyi grags pas mdzad pa'o// 'di shin tu zab pas gsang zhing sba ba gal che'o// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
